text:
olivia: Incoming vendor invoice from DataMesh (2400011223) includes a prepay credit reversal and a usage shortfall charge. Total due: $15,780. Need month-end guidance on recognition and whether to apply to earlier deferrals.
samir: Can you attach the invoice + the original prepay agreement?
til: attached: /invoices/vendor/datamesh/2400011223.pdf and /contracts/prepay-datamesh-2025.pdf
paul: Quick read: vendor reversed a $10k prepay credit because we dipped below commit threshold; remaining $5,780 is usage overage. Their contract allows clawback on shortfall. How do we handle reversal against previous deferrals?
olivia: If we previously recognized revenue deferral reduction because of prepay credit, we should reclassify and book the clawback as a contra-revenue or reduce the prepay asset. Need GL team input.
samir: GL-impact: reduce Prepaid Vendor Credits (asset) by $10k and recognize usage expense or contra-rev for the clawback. The $5,780 usage overage is straightforward expense in the period.
ton: Do we have a journal template? Also need FP&A approval for any reclassification >$10k.
paul: I'll prepare the JE and tag FP&A. Draft below:
``
Date: 2026-03-31
Dr: Prepaid Vendor Credits (Asset)    10,000
Dr: Cloud Services Expense             5,780
Cr: Accounts Payable                    15,780
Memo: DataMesh invoice 2400011223 - prepay credit reversal and usage shortfall
```
samir: Sounds right. Also add close note: we recognized deferred revenue impact on prepay reversal in prior months; need to footnote the restatement if material to prior period.
olivia: I'll ping FP&A for sign-off. Tagging monthend/close and revenue-rec team.
it-invoices-bot: Invoice saved to /invoices/vendor/datamesh/2400011223.pdf
paul: Action: post JE after FP&A sign-off. If no reply by EOD, post provisional JE and chase approval tomorrow.
olivia: Thanks all. Will update thread with FP&A response.
